apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged once per run (Apify synthetic start event; priced per GB of run memory, 1 GB minimum). Target ~$0.001 for a typical 256 MB–1 GB start.

domain-verdict.eventDescription: Charged once per domain that received a clear verdict (available or registered). Unknown/error rows are free unless chargeFailedDomains is enabled. Invalid inputs that never become a row are not charged.
